summary.content:
Today's selection covers 91 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Chinese A.I. Models Gain Ground on Anthropic and OpenAI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: And the Winner in Dominant Malware Delivery? ClickFix
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 43 articles published in the last 24 hours
